text: OVERDOSAGE Reports of acute toxicity and/or death following over-dosage of glucocorticoids are rare. In the event of over-dosage, no specific antidote is available; treatment is supportive and symptomatic. The oral LD 50 of dexamethasone in female mice was 6.5 g/kg. The intravenous LD 50 of dexamethasone sodium phosphate in female mice was 794mg/kg.
